coverage.description: Greater Mumbai bounding box; road classes motorway to tertiary (with links)

provenance.notes: Nodes are intersections and way endpoints; edges are road segments between them. Residential and service roads are excluded to keep the graph explainable.

assumptions.travelTime: DERIVED_ESTIMATE: length / speed, where speed is the OSM maxspeed tag when present, otherwise the class default free-flow speed. Not live traffic.
assumptions.capacity: MODELLED_PROXY: lanes per direction (OSM lanes tag, halved for two-way roads, else class default) x per-lane capacity by class (vehicles/hour). Not measured throughput.
